title: Microsoft Windows Active Directory–Integrated DNS
description: Active Directory–integrated DNS providing name resolution, service location, and secure dynamic updates for Active Directory domains. This component represents DNS as a Tier-0 dependency and is instantiated per domain.

implemented-requirements.description: AD-integrated DNS provides secure name resolution services with authenticated and integrity-protected dynamic updates.
DNS services are tightly integrated with Active Directory authentication mechanisms to prevent spoofing and unauthorized updates.
DNS is treated as a boundary service whose exposure and recursion behavior are restricted to limit lateral movement and abuse.
